body.message:
Hello Melina,

Thank you for your message. We have well noted your request.

We would like to inform you that our apartments are generally not pet-friendly. However, if the guest has a pet, we can certainly check for suitable options, but please note that additional charges may apply, subject to the property owner's approval.

We will also check if we have any available properties that match your requirements and budget and get back to you with suitable options.

Unfortunately, we are unable to create a WhatsApp group with the property owner.

Could you also let us know if you have any preferred location? This will help us narrow down the most suitable options for you.

Thank you, and we look forward to assisting you.
